article.title: Google AI Mode現相關文章卡片，記者觀察Dive deeper逐步出現
article.title_en: Reporters observe Dive deeper article cards appearing in Google AI Mode
article.summary: Search Engine Roundtable於11月23日報道，記者已在AI Mode看見Google較早公布的Dive deeper文章連結。
article.summary_en: Search Engine Roundtable reported on November 23 that reporters were seeing the previously announced Dive deeper links in AI Mode.
highlights: 部分答案末端出現藍色連結、縮圖及文章說明。
Google於10月15日公布設計；這次是介面出現的觀察，並非全球可用確認。
highlights_en: Some answer endings display blue links, thumbnails and article descriptions.
Google announced the design on October 15; this is an observed rollout rather than confirmation of universal access.
article.why: 品牌內容多了一種可能被AI答案帶出的位置，編輯團隊可分開觀察卡片是否出現，以及是否真正帶來網站回流。
article.why_en: Brand editors can distinguish article-card visibility from actual referral traffic as another link surface appears beside AI answers.
article.next_step: 選三個與既有文章相關的查詢，記錄答案末端是否有卡片、所用縮圖及連結，再對照網站實際回流資料。
article.next_step_en: Record end-of-answer cards, thumbnails and destinations for three relevant queries, then compare them with actual site referrals.
article.detail: 報道作者Barry Schwartz及搜尋顧問Glenn Gabe均描述看見相關介面，文章亦展示例圖。作者提醒需向下捲過較長的AI內容才到達這組連結。這與增加點擊是兩回事，現有資料未提供回流成效。團隊可記下查詢、日期及可見介面，與既有搜尋來源分開觀察，避免把偶爾出現的卡片當作穩定流量。
article.detail_en: Barry Schwartz and search consultant Glenn Gabe describe seeing the interface, with examples in the report. Schwartz notes the section can sit below substantial AI-generated content. No referral uplift is established. Record queries, dates and visible layouts separately from existing search sources before treating the cards as a dependable channel.
